isolation: Procedural blinding within a shared filesystem.
coordination_messages: Initial identical scope/schema instructions with distinct expert perspectives; structural verification that packet report and compact steps match source files; progress requests. No substantive votes or case-specific advice sent between reviewers.
original_judgments_policy: Retain independent first-round judgments. Mechanical schema or quotation corrections, if needed, do not resolve substantive disagreements.
unblinding: None: coordinator and reviewers do not inspect source mappings, hidden truth, original scores or previous study outcomes.
reviewer_identity_basis: Three certified Master Black Belt practitioners engaged by the authors.
scope_restriction: Supply only PROTOCOL.md, assigned order file and six specified case files.
ai_assistance: None. The reviewers worked without AI tools.
